title: Donald Trump returns to White House Correspondents' dinner months after shooting forced postponement
summary_full: President Trump attended the rescheduled White House Correspondents' Association dinner.  This event followed a shooting incident outside the original venue in April.  The president addressed journalists from major news organizations after months of media clashes.  The dinner celebrated press freedom and raised money for journalism scholarships.  Heightened security measures were in place for Friday's event at the Waldorf Astoria.
